name: Elusive Treasure Goblin
flavor: A cackling goblin clutching a sack stuffed with unimaginable riches has been spotted in the area. It is terrifyingly fast and wants nothing to do with anyone — but killing it would be very profitable.

history_events.begin: A treasure goblin has been spotted in the area, fleeing with a sack full of riches.
history_events.end: The treasure goblin has escaped — or been slain — and its hoard is gone.
